title: Flock Safety Contract - White Oak Texas

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

A copy of any Contract, Agreement, or Memorandum of Understanding between any Department of the City of White Oak and Flock Group Inc. (DBA Flock Safety).

Excluded from this request:

Confidential information deemed protected by Texas Law, Statute or Attorney General Ruling.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Harry Sisson

title: GLADEWATER - TEXAS - Texas Open Records Documents

communications.subject: Texas Public Information Act Request: GLADEWATER - TEXAS - Texas Open Records Documents
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Texas Public Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Texas Statute 552.205(b) requires a sign to be displayed informing the public of their rights.  -  I am requesting a copy of the sign currently being displayed by the City of Gladewater.

Texas Statute 552.012(e) requires training for the Public Information Officer. - I am requesting a copy of the certificate issued upon completion of the training.

Texas Statute 552.234(a) requires the City to accept Open Records requests by the following methods: (1)  United States mail; (2)  electronic mail; (3)  hand delivery. - I am requesting a screenshot of the City's website, or link, that provides this information to the public.

Texas Statute 552.234(e) requires the City to notify the Texas Attorney General the current mailing address and email address designated by the governmental body to receive requests. -  I am requesting a screenshot of the OAG's website, or link, displaying the information the City provided.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Toby Martin

To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the New York Freedom of Information Law, I hereby request the following records:

Records related to the department’s Flock Safety system:
1. Organization Audit in Flock.
The report should include data logged from the period of January 1, 2026, to the date this request is processed. Per Flock's documentation, the Organization Audit is available within the Insights tab and is defined as searches done within the agency.

2. Network Audit in Flock.
The report should include data logged from the period of January 1, 2026, to the date this request is processed. Per Flock's documentation, the Network Audit is available within the Insights tab and is defined as searches of the organization’s Flock network by any agency in the Flock System.

3. A list of network share settings that include:
3a. Flock networks shared with the Department
3b. Networks that the Department is sharing

4. Flock Safety Event Log.
The report should include data logged from the periods of January 1, 2020 to January 1, 2025 and June 11, 2026 to the date this request is processed. Per Flock's documentation, the Event Log is available within the Insights tab. Flock customer support may be able to assist with the mass-downloading of this data if assistance is required.

Records relating to the department's ALPR policy:
5. All versions of the written policy for the deployment of automated license plate recognition cameras/readers/systems, as well as for usage, storage and sharing of any data obtained by using such systems, including General Order O-58 and any policy preceding it, together with records showing each version's effective date and review date.

6. For the period January 1, 2020 to the date this request is processed: all records of periodic and/or random audits and inspections of ALPR use and ALPR data conducted pursuant to General Order O-58 § IV.C.7, including the audit reports themselves, findings, worksheets, spreadsheets, checklists, scoring rubrics, sampling methodology, and any corrective-action recommendations.

7. For the period January 1, 2020 to the date this request is processed: all records establishing the procedures and practices adopted to evaluate and monitor the use of LPR data and measure compliance of use with ALPR policy, as required by General Order O-58 § IV.C.7 - including any standard operating procedure, audit protocol, directive, memorandum, or training bulletin describing how such audits are conducted, how often, and by whom.

8. All department communications (including email) concerning ALPR audits, inspections, compliance review, or policy violations written from the period of January 1, 2022 to the date this request is processed.

9. All records of any identified violation of General Order O-58, including compliance notices, counseling memoranda, supervisory referrals, internal affairs complaints or investigations, findings, and any resulting discipline, concerning ALPR use or ALPR data.

10. All ALPR training records, including rosters, sign-in sheets, certificates, lesson plans, and curricula for ALPR training on (a) use of the technology, (b) the LPR policy and procedures, and (c) applicable laws and privacy protections; and any training bulletins issued.

11. Records identifying the individual(s) designated as Agency LPR Administrator under General Order O-58 § III and § IV.C.1, including the designation memorandum and the dates each individual held that role.

12. The list of active authorized users with access to the ALPR system maintained under General Order O-58 § IV.C.1.c, and records of additions to or removals from that list, from January 1, 2020 to the date this request is processed.

13. Records reflecting coordination with the vendor regarding user accounts added by the vendor, as contemplated by General Order O-58 § IV.C.1.d.

Please provide records in their original electronic, machine readable format. For example, please provide csv or spreadsheet files where applicable.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter.

Sincerely,

Scott Conway
